correctness.rationale: Exact \(\mathbb F_5\) reconstruction gives \(\dim C=\dim D=8\) and stacked rank \(16\), so the displayed modules form an LCP. The exact nullspace gives \(D^\perp\). Exhausting all \(5^8\) words of each side yields identical Hamming histograms and minimum distance \(7\). Complete composition counting gives \(8\) versus \(0\) for \((9,0,0,1,6)\). Since coordinate permutations preserve ordered symbol counts, this proves permutation inequivalence.

value.rationale: The source explicitly motivates quasi-cyclic LCPs by the fact that their two security sides need not be permutation equivalent, while security itself sees only their minimum distances. This example sharpens that distinction substantially: not only the minimum distances but the entire ordinary Hamming spectra agree, so every Hamming-weight statistic is blind to the inequivalence. A complete-composition obstruction at the minimum layer is a natural and exact structural boundary showing where ordinary weight data cease to distinguish the two sides.
